title: CycloneDX AI/ML Model
$comment: OWASP CycloneDX is an Ecma International standard (ECMA-424) developed in collaboration between the OWASP Foundation and Ecma Technical Committee 54 (TC54). The standard is published under a royalty-free patent policy. This JSON schema is the reference implementation and is licensed under the Apache License 2.0.

modelProperties.title: AI/ML Model Properties
modelProperties.description: Intrinsic technical characteristics of a machine learning model. This object SHOULD be specified for any component of type `machine-learning-model` and shall not be specified for other component types. Contextual and subjective aspects of a model, including ethical and fairness considerations, potential harms, groups at risk, and impact assessments, are expressed with the risk model and reference the model component. Views of this data tailored to a specific audience, such as a model card, are expressed with perspectives.

learningTypes.title: Learning Types
learningTypes.description: The learning paradigms applied when training the model. A model may combine several paradigms, for example self-supervised pre-training followed by supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning based alignment.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.description: The machine learning tasks the model is designed to perform. Tasks directly influence the intended use, the input and output characteristics, and the applicable evaluation metrics of the model. A model may support multiple tasks.

parameterCount.title: Parameter Count
parameterCount.description: The total number of trainable parameters of the model.

quantization.title: Quantization
quantization.description: The quantization applied to the model weights as distributed. Quantization of individual input and output tensors is expressed on the model parameters.

inputs.title: Model Inputs
inputs.description: The input parameters accepted by the model.

outputs.title: Model Outputs
outputs.description: The output parameters produced by the model.

training.title: Training
training.description: Information about how the model was trained.

evaluation.title: Evaluation
evaluation.description: A quantitative evaluation of the model.

limitations.title: Limitations
limitations.description: Known technical limitations of the model, including constraints on accuracy, reasoning, scalability, and appropriate use. Limitations that expose users or other parties to potential harm should also be documented with the risk model.

useCases.title: Use Cases
useCases.description: References to use cases, defined elsewhere in the BOM, that describe the intended uses of the model.

environmental.title: Environmental Impact
environmental.description: Measured environmental impacts of the model across its lifecycle activities.

externalReferences.title: External References
externalReferences.description: External references to resources that are relevant to the model but are not included with the BOM.

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: Provides the ability to document name-value pairs for the model. Property names of interest to the general public are encouraged to be registered in the [CycloneDX Property Taxonomy](https://github.com/CycloneDX/cyclonedx-property-taxonomy). Formal registration is optional.

learningType.title: Learning Type
learningType.description: A learning paradigm applied when training a machine learning model. Use the custom option for paradigms not covered by the predefined values.

meta:enum.supervised: The model learns from labelled data to map inputs to known outputs.
meta:enum.unsupervised: The model learns patterns and structure from unlabelled data.
meta:enum.semi-supervised: The model learns from a combination of labelled and unlabelled data.
meta:enum.self-supervised: The model learns from supervisory signals derived automatically from the data itself.
meta:enum.reinforcement-learning: The model learns a policy by acting in an environment and receiving reward signals, including reward signals derived from human or automated feedback.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the custom learning paradigm.

description.title: Description
description.description: A description of the custom learning paradigm.

modelTask.title: Model Task
modelTask.description: A machine learning task that a model is designed to perform. Use the custom option for tasks not covered by the predefined values.

meta:enum.text-generation: Generate coherent text continuations from prompts.
meta:enum.text-classification: Classify text into predefined categories, for example sentiment analysis or topic classification.
meta:enum.token-classification: Classify individual tokens in text, for example named entity recognition or part-of-speech tagging.
meta:enum.question-answering: Answer questions based on context or knowledge, using extractive or generative approaches.
meta:enum.summarization: Generate concise summaries of longer text documents.
meta:enum.translation: Translate text from one language to another.
meta:enum.text-to-text: Transform text from one form to another, for example paraphrasing or style transfer.
meta:enum.fill-mask: Predict masked tokens in text, as in masked language modelling.
meta:enum.sentence-similarity: Compute semantic similarity between text sequences.
meta:enum.text-to-video: Generate video content from text descriptions.
meta:enum.text-to-audio: Generate audio or music from text descriptions.
meta:enum.text-to-speech: Convert text to spoken audio through speech synthesis.
meta:enum.image-segmentation: Segment images into regions or objects using semantic or instance segmentation.
meta:enum.object-detection: Detect and localize objects in images.
meta:enum.image-to-image: Transform images, for example style transfer, super-resolution, or inpainting.
meta:enum.image-to-text: Generate text descriptions from images, for example image captioning.
meta:enum.audio-classification: Classify audio into categories, for example sound event detection.
meta:enum.audio-to-audio: Transform audio, for example noise reduction or voice conversion.
meta:enum.voice-activity-detection: Detect the presence of speech in audio streams.
meta:enum.tabular-regression: Predict continuous values from structured tabular data.
meta:enum.time-series-forecasting: Predict future values in time series data.
meta:enum.reinforcement-learning: Learn optimal actions through interaction with an environment.
meta:enum.robotics: Control and decision making for robotic systems.
meta:enum.graph-ml: Machine learning tasks on graph structured data.
meta:enum.feature-extraction: Extract meaningful features or representations from data.
meta:enum.embedding: Generate dense vector representations of data.
meta:enum.zero-shot-classification: Classify data without task specific training examples.
meta:enum.few-shot-learning: Learn from very few examples per class.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the custom machine learning task.

description.title: Description
description.description: A description of the custom machine learning task.

architectureFamily.title: Architecture Family
architectureFamily.description: The core structural family of a model. Use the custom option for families not covered by the predefined values.

meta:enum.transformer: Architecture based on self-attention mechanisms for processing sequential or spatial data.
meta:enum.cnn: Convolutional neural network using convolutional layers for processing grid structured data.
meta:enum.rnn: Recurrent neural network with recurrent connections for sequential data processing.
meta:enum.lstm: Long short-term memory network, a recurrent variant with gating mechanisms for long-term dependencies.
meta:enum.gru: Gated recurrent unit network, a recurrent variant with simplified gating.
meta:enum.gan: Generative adversarial network, a dual network framework containing a generator and a discriminator.
meta:enum.vae: Variational autoencoder, a probabilistic encoder and decoder architecture mapping to a latent space.
meta:enum.mamba: State space model architecture with selective mechanisms for efficient sequence modelling.
meta:enum.ssm: State space model based on continuous or discrete state space representations.
meta:enum.gnn: Graph neural network optimized for processing graph structured data.
meta:enum.mlp: Multilayer perceptron, a feedforward architecture composed entirely of fully connected layers.
meta:enum.rwkv: Receptance weighted key value architecture combining parallelizable training with recurrent inference.
meta:enum.snn: Spiking neural network, a neuromorphic architecture utilizing discrete, time dependent spiking activations.
meta:enum.kan: Kolmogorov-Arnold network featuring learnable activation functions on edges rather than nodes.
meta:enum.diffusion: Denoising diffusion model that iteratively refines noise into data.
meta:enum.flow-matching: Continuous normalizing flow trained with flow matching or rectified flow objectives.
meta:enum.rbm: Restricted Boltzmann machine, an energy based generative model with stochastic hidden units.
meta:enum.capsnet: Capsule network using dynamic routing between capsule groups to preserve spatial hierarchies.
meta:enum.neuromorphic: Architecture designed for deployment on neuromorphic hardware.
meta:enum.hybrid: Explicit combination of two or more distinct architecture families.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the custom architecture family.

description.title: Description
description.description: A description of the custom architecture family.

architectureFeature.title: Architecture Feature
architectureFeature.description: A structural feature or mechanism present in a model, including macro level layouts, attention variants, and parameter efficient adaptation mechanisms. Use the custom option for features not covered by the predefined values.

meta:enum.decoder-only: Autoregressive layout that attends to prior positions only.
meta:enum.encoder-only: Bidirectional layout that processes complete sequences simultaneously.
meta:enum.encoder-decoder: Sequence to sequence structure mapping an input representation to an output sequence.
meta:enum.mixture-of-experts: Sparse routing mechanism activating specific expert subnetworks per token.
meta:enum.vae-bottleneck: Symmetric compression bottleneck utilizing mean and variance latent vectors.
meta:enum.u-net: Symmetric contracting and expanding layout featuring skip connections between corresponding scales.
meta:enum.residual-connections: Explicit skip or identity shortcuts bypassing one or more structural layers.
meta:enum.dual-encoders: Parallel feature extraction pipelines mapping different inputs into a shared space.
meta:enum.cross-attention: Mechanism that conditions one feature stream on another through attention.
meta:enum.siamese-network: Twin subnetworks sharing identical weights to compute similarity metrics.
meta:enum.hybrid-backbone: Direct cascading combination of distinct architecture families, for example a convolutional feature extractor feeding a transformer.
meta:enum.vision-encoder: Vision encoding component for processing image inputs in multimodal architectures.
meta:enum.adapter-layers: Parameter efficient fine-tuning layers inserted into otherwise frozen models.
meta:enum.gated-linear-units: Gated activation mechanisms using element-wise multiplication.
meta:enum.speculative-decoding: Pairing of a small draft model with a larger verifier model to accelerate autoregressive generation.
meta:enum.rotary-position-embedding: Positional encoding applied through rotation matrices.
meta:enum.grouped-query-attention: Attention variant sharing key and value heads across groups of query heads.
meta:enum.sliding-window-attention: Attention mechanism restricting the receptive field to a local sliding window.
meta:enum.retrieval-augmented: Retrieval component prepended to or integrated into the model.
meta:enum.memory-augmented: External or persistent memory bank integrated into the forward pass.
meta:enum.multimodal-fusion: Layer or block that fuses representations across more than one modality.
meta:enum.reranker: Separate scoring or reranking head applied after an initial retrieval or generation step.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the custom architecture feature.

description.title: Description
description.description: A description of the custom architecture feature.

architectureTopology.title: Architecture Topology
architectureTopology.description: The runtime parameter activation and connection structure of a model. Use the custom option for topologies not covered by the predefined values.

meta:enum.dense: All or most parameters are active during inference with full connectivity between layers.
meta:enum.sparse: Only a subset of parameters is active during inference with selective connectivity.
meta:enum.dynamic: Parameter activation and connectivity patterns change based on input or runtime conditions.
meta:enum.liquid: Continuously adaptive network structure with time varying connections and activations.
meta:enum.mixture-of-depths: Tokens are routed to different computational depths rather than to different expert modules.
meta:enum.early-exit: Inference exits at the earliest layer that meets a confidence threshold, reducing compute for easy inputs.
meta:enum.recurrent-hybrid: Static layer layout that alternates between global attention and recurrent or state space layers.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the custom topology.

description.title: Description
description.description: A description of the custom topology.

modelArchitecture.title: Model Architecture
modelArchitecture.description: The architecture of a machine learning model, including its structural family, notable features, and topology.

name.title: Name
name.description: The identifying name of the model architecture, typically a well known architecture variant.

description.title: Description
description.description: A description of the architecture, including key characteristics, design decisions, and architectural innovations.

family.title: Family
family.description: The core structural family of the model.

features.title: Features
features.description: Structural features and mechanisms present in the model.

topology.title: Topology
topology.description: The runtime parameter activation and connection structure of the model.

externalReferences.title: External References
externalReferences.description: External references to resources that are relevant to the model architecture but are not included with the BOM.

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: Provides the ability to document name-value pairs for the model architecture. Property names of interest to the general public are encouraged to be registered in the [CycloneDX Property Taxonomy](https://github.com/CycloneDX/cyclonedx-property-taxonomy). Formal registration is optional.

modality.title: Modality
modality.description: The type of data a model parameter carries. Use the custom option for modalities not covered by the predefined values.

meta:enum.text: Natural language text input or output.
meta:enum.image: Visual image data input or output.
meta:enum.audio: Audio or speech data input or output.
meta:enum.multimodal: Combined multiple modalities, for example text and image.
meta:enum.embedding: Dense vector representations in a continuous space.
meta:enum.logits: Raw unnormalized model outputs before activation functions.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the custom modality.

description.title: Description
description.description: A description of the custom modality.

quantization.title: Quantization
quantization.description: The quantization applied to a model parameter. The scheme parameters recorded here describe how quantized values relate to real values. The scale and zero point tensors themselves are model data and are distributed with the model artefact, not with the BOM. Additional scheme specific details may be recorded in the `properties` of the model parameter.

method.title: Method
method.description: The quantization method or algorithm applied.

bits.title: Bits
bits.description: The nominal bit width per value. Fractional widths are permitted, for example 1.58 for ternary quantization.

scheme.title: Scheme
scheme.description: The mapping between quantized values and real values.

meta:enum.affine: Asymmetric mapping using a scale and a zero point.
meta:enum.symmetric: Symmetric mapping using a scale with the zero point fixed at zero.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the custom quantization scheme.

description.title: Description
description.description: A description of the custom quantization scheme.

granularity.title: Granularity
granularity.description: The level at which scales and zero points are assigned.

meta:enum.per-tensor: One scale and zero point applies to the entire tensor.
meta:enum.per-channel: Scales and zero points are assigned along one tensor axis.
meta:enum.per-group: Scales and zero points are assigned to fixed size groups of elements along one tensor axis.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the custom quantization granularity.

description.title: Description
description.description: A description of the custom quantization granularity.

groupSize.title: Group Size
groupSize.description: The number of elements sharing one scale and zero point when the granularity is `per-group`.

axis.title: Axis
axis.description: The tensor axis along which scales and zero points are assigned when the granularity is `per-channel` or `per-group`.

modelParameter.title: Model Parameter
modelParameter.description: A single input or output parameter of a machine learning model. Parameter specific details not covered by the predefined fields may be recorded in `properties`.

description.title: Description
description.description: A description of the parameter and its purpose.

modality.title: Modality
modality.description: The type of data this parameter carries.

dataType.title: Data Type
dataType.description: The numeric or symbolic data type of the parameter values.

mimeType.title: MIME Type
mimeType.description: The media type of the parameter data.

quantization.title: Quantization
quantization.description: The quantization applied to the parameter values.

shape.title: Shape
shape.description: The dimensional shape of the parameter, for example tensor dimensions. A dynamic dimension is expressed as null or -1.

processingStage.title: Processing Stage
processingStage.description: The processing stage of the parameter relative to tokenization or encoding.

meta:enum.pre-tokenizer: Data before tokenization, for example a raw text string.
meta:enum.post-tokenizer: Data after tokenization, for example token identifiers.
meta:enum.pre-processing: Data before any processing pipeline has been applied.
meta:enum.post-processing: Data after all processing steps have been applied.

required.title: Required
required.description: Indicates whether this parameter is required.

defaultValue.title: Default Value
defaultValue.description: The default value for the parameter when a value is not provided.

externalReferences.title: External References
externalReferences.description: External references to resources that are relevant to the parameter but are not included with the BOM.

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: Provides the ability to document name-value pairs for the parameter. Property names of interest to the general public are encouraged to be registered in the [CycloneDX Property Taxonomy](https://github.com/CycloneDX/cyclonedx-property-taxonomy). Formal registration is optional.

parameterConstraints.title: Parameter Constraints
parameterConstraints.description: Constraints on the values of a model parameter.

minLength.title: Minimum Length
minLength.description: The minimum length for text or sequence parameters.

maxLength.title: Maximum Length
maxLength.description: The maximum length for text or sequence parameters.

allowedValues.title: Allowed Values
allowedValues.description: The list of permitted values for the parameter.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.description: A regular expression pattern that string values of the parameter match.

datasetChoice.title: Dataset Choice
datasetChoice.description: A reference to a dataset documented as a component of type `data`, either within this BOM by `bom-ref` or in another BOM by BOM-Link.

anyOf.title: Dataset Reference
anyOf.description: A reference to a component of type `data` within this BOM.

anyOf.title: Dataset BOM-Link Reference
anyOf.description: A BOM-Link reference to a component of type `data` in another BOM.

training.title: Training
training.description: Information about how a model was trained, including references to the datasets used and to the formula that captures the training process. Detailed training and data preparation workflows, including their inputs, outputs, and processing steps, are expressed with formulation and referenced from here.

formula.title: Formula Reference
formula.description: References a formula, defined in formulation, that describes how the model was trained, for example as sequenced phases of pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, and alignment tuning.

datasets.title: Training Datasets
datasets.description: References to the datasets used for training or fine-tuning the model.

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: Provides the ability to document name-value pairs for the training process. Property names of interest to the general public are encouraged to be registered in the [CycloneDX Property Taxonomy](https://github.com/CycloneDX/cyclonedx-property-taxonomy). Formal registration is optional.

evaluation.title: Evaluation
evaluation.description: A quantitative evaluation of a model, including performance metrics and supporting graphics such as confusion matrices and calibration plots.

metrics.title: Performance Metrics
metrics.description: The performance metrics being reported, for example accuracy, F1 score, precision, or benchmark scores.

graphics.title: Graphics
graphics.description: A collection of graphics that represent various measurements.

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: Provides the ability to document name-value pairs for the evaluation. Property names of interest to the general public are encouraged to be registered in the [CycloneDX Property Taxonomy](https://github.com/CycloneDX/cyclonedx-property-taxonomy). Formal registration is optional.

performanceMeasure.title: Performance Measure
performanceMeasure.description: A measure of model performance with a value and a unit. The unit is constrained to the predefined unit sets for time, throughput, compute, memory, and ratio measurements.

performanceMetric.title: Performance Metric
performanceMetric.description: A reported performance metric of a model. Benchmarks and evaluation methodologies evolve rapidly, so the metric type and benchmark name are open strings; external references and evaluation dataset references establish the identity, version, and provenance of the evaluation.

type.title: Metric Type
type.description: The type of performance metric being reported.

benchmark.title: Benchmark
benchmark.description: The name of the benchmark or evaluation suite that produced the metric, if any.

measure.title: Measure
measure.description: The measured value of the performance metric with its unit.

slice.title: Slice
slice.description: The name of the data slice on which the metric was computed, for example a demographic group, a language, or a domain. When absent, the metric applies to the entire evaluation population. Slice level metrics provide the quantitative evidence for fairness and bias risks documented with the risk model.

confidenceInterval.title: Confidence Interval
confidenceInterval.description: The confidence interval of the metric.

lowerBound.title: Lower Bound
lowerBound.description: The lower bound of the confidence interval.

upperBound.title: Upper Bound
upperBound.description: The upper bound of the confidence interval.

evaluationDatasets.title: Evaluation Datasets
evaluationDatasets.description: References to the datasets or dataset subsets used to compute this performance metric.

externalReferences.title: External References
externalReferences.description: External references to resources that are relevant to the metric, such as benchmark definitions, leaderboards, or evaluation methodologies but are not included with the BOM.

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: Provides the ability to document name-value pairs for the metric. Property names of interest to the general public are encouraged to be registered in the [CycloneDX Property Taxonomy](https://github.com/CycloneDX/cyclonedx-property-taxonomy). Formal registration is optional.

environmental.title: Environmental Impact
environmental.description: Measured environmental impacts of a model across its lifecycle activities. This object captures factual measurements. Environmental risks informed by these measurements are expressed with the risk model and reference the model component.

energyConsumptions.title: Energy Consumptions
energyConsumptions.description: The energy consumption incurred for one or more lifecycle activities of the model.

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: Provides the ability to document name-value pairs for environmental impact. Property names of interest to the general public are encouraged to be registered in the [CycloneDX Property Taxonomy](https://github.com/CycloneDX/cyclonedx-property-taxonomy). Formal registration is optional.

modelActivity.title: Model Activity
modelActivity.description: An activity that is part of the development or operational lifecycle of a machine learning model. Use the custom option for activities not covered by the predefined values.

meta:enum.design: Model design, including problem framing, goal definition, and algorithm selection.
meta:enum.data-collection: Model data acquisition, including search, selection, and transfer.
meta:enum.data-preparation: Model data preparation, including data cleaning, labelling, and conversion.
meta:enum.training: Model building, training, and generalized tuning.
meta:enum.fine-tuning: Refining a trained model to produce desired outputs for a given problem space.
meta:enum.validation: Model validation, including model output evaluation and testing.
meta:enum.deployment: Model deployment to a target hosting infrastructure.
meta:enum.inference: Generating an output response from a hosted model from a set of inputs.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the custom activity.

description.title: Description
description.description: A description of the custom activity.

energyConsumption.title: Energy Consumption
energyConsumption.description: The energy consumption incurred for a specific lifecycle activity of a model.

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: The lifecycle activity that incurred the energy consumption.

formula.title: Formula Reference
formula.description: References a formula, defined in formulation, that captures the process which incurred this energy consumption, for example a training workflow.

energyProviders.title: Energy Providers
energyProviders.description: The providers of the energy consumed by the activity.

activityEnergyCost.title: Activity Energy Cost
activityEnergyCost.description: The total energy cost associated with the activity.

co2CostEquivalent.title: CO2 Equivalent Cost
co2CostEquivalent.description: The carbon dioxide equivalent cost of the total energy cost.

co2CostOffset.title: CO2 Cost Offset
co2CostOffset.description: The carbon dioxide offset credited against the carbon dioxide equivalent cost.

externalReferences.title: External References
externalReferences.description: External references to resources that are relevant to the energy consumption but are not included with the BOM.

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: Provides the ability to document name-value pairs for the energy consumption. Property names of interest to the general public are encouraged to be registered in the [CycloneDX Property Taxonomy](https://github.com/CycloneDX/cyclonedx-property-taxonomy). Formal registration is optional.

energySource.title: Energy Source
energySource.description: The source of the energy provided by an energy provider. Use the custom option for sources not covered by the predefined values.

meta:enum.oil: Energy produced from petroleum products, primarily crude oil and its derivative fuel oils.
meta:enum.natural-gas: Energy produced from hydrocarbon gases, including natural gas, ethane, and propane.
meta:enum.nuclear: Energy produced from the cores of atoms through nuclear fission or fusion.
meta:enum.geothermal: Energy produced from heat within the earth.
meta:enum.biofuel: Energy produced from liquid fuels derived from biomass feedstocks.
meta:enum.biomass: Energy produced from solid organic materials such as wood, agricultural crops, or organic waste.
meta:enum.hydrogen: Energy produced from hydrogen fuel in fuel cells or combustion.
meta:enum.tidal: Energy produced from the rise and fall of ocean tides and tidal currents.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the custom energy source.

description.title: Description
description.description: A description of the custom energy source.

energyProvider.title: Energy Provider
energyProvider.description: The provider of energy consumed during model development or operations.

bom-ref.title: BOM Reference
bom-ref.description:
An identifier which can be used to reference the energy provider elsewhere in the BOM. Every `bom-ref` must be unique within the BOM.
Value SHOULD not start with the BOM-Link intro 'urn:cdx:' to avoid conflicts with BOM-Links.

description.title: Description
description.description: A description of the energy provider.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: The party that provides the consumed energy, typically an organization.

energySource.title: Energy Source
energySource.description: The source of the provided energy.

energyProvided.title: Energy Provided
energyProvided.description: The energy provided by the energy source for the associated activity.

externalReferences.title: External References
externalReferences.description: External references to resources that are relevant to the energy provider but are not included with the BOM.

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: Provides the ability to document name-value pairs for the energy provider. Property names of interest to the general public are encouraged to be registered in the [CycloneDX Property Taxonomy](https://github.com/CycloneDX/cyclonedx-property-taxonomy). Formal registration is optional.
